ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הָיָה עֶבֶד, אֲבָל עָבַד בֶּאֱמוּנָה וְזָכָה לְאֵמוּן.
ideas.children_en: Joseph was sold as a slave to Potiphar's house in Egypt. God was with Joseph, so he succeeded a lot in managing the house. Potiphar trusted him and let him manage everything because he saw Joseph was honest and good at it.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף סֵרֵב לַעֲשׂוֹת מַשֶּׁהוּ שֶׁנָּגַד אֶת עֶקְרוֹנוֹתָיו.
ideas.children_en: Potiphar's wife wanted Joseph to lie with her, but Joseph said no. He did not want to betray her husband or his own values. She tried many times, but he always avoided her.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁמִּישֶׁהוּ לוֹחֵץ עָלֵינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת דָּבָר לֹא נָכוֹן, מֻתָּר לְהִתְרַחֵק.
ideas.children_en: One day, when everyone was out, Potiphar's wife tried again with Joseph. She grabbed his coat, and Joseph ran away, leaving it in her hand.

ideas.children_he: שֶׁקֶר עָלוּל לִפְגֹּעַ בְּאָדָם חַף מִפֶּשַׁע.
ideas.children_en: Potiphar's wife felt hurt because Joseph said no. She wanted revenge and told lies about him to the household and Potiphar, saying Joseph tried to harm her.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף נִשְׁלַח לְבֵית הַסֹּהַר, אֲבָל לֹא וִתֵּר עַל יָשְׁרוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Potiphar put Joseph in prison without a trial. There, Joseph gained favor with the prison chief because he was trusted and succeeded even in jail.

ideas.children_he: גַּם בְּמָקוֹם קָשֶׁה אֶפְשָׁר לְהַרְאוֹת אַחֲרָיוּת וְלִזְכּוֹת בְּאֵמוּן.
ideas.children_en: The prison chief gave Joseph charge over all prisoners because Joseph did well and was trusted. Joseph set the rules in prison, and God was with him even there.
